title: Siawi language
text: The Siawi language, assigned the ISO 639-3 code mmp, is primarily known by its exonym "Siawi" in linguistic literature and international databases.[4][2] Alternative names for Siawi include Musan, Musa, Musian, Siafli, and Siwai, reflecting variations used in ethnographic and missionary records as well as early linguistic surveys.[2][5] These designations appear in classifications of Papuan languages, where Siawi is grouped within the small Amto-Musan family alongside Amto.[6] In some regional surveys of Sandaun Province languages, Siawi is treated as a dialect of Amto, with shared alternate names such as Ki, Siwai, Siawi, and Siafli for the broader variety; this nomenclature aids identification in governmental mapping and documentation efforts in Papua New Guinea.[7]
